2121253789067870493.en_summary: $NBIS went from +200% to +28% YTD. A lot of AI stocks have seen similar sell-offs. Stocks are very unpredictable. Who would have predicted Jensen’s affair + resignation? Unexpected events can hit share prices hard. Taking profits is a must in this sector.
2121253789067870493.zh_summary: $NBIS 從年初至今 +200% 降至 +28%。許多 AI 股票出現類似拋售。股票非常不可預測。誰能預測 Jensen 的風流韻事 + 辭職？這類意外事件可重創股價。因此認為在此板塊獲利了結是必須的。
